mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is used before uncountable nouns or nouns which indicate an unspecified or undetermined amount or quantity e.g.
The partitive article is used before uncountable nouns or nouns which indicate an unspecified or undetermined amount or quantity e.g.
Fill in the blank: ______ are used to show the sex of a noun that is distinct but not specific.
The indefinite articles are used to show the sex of a noun that is distinct but not specific.
Fill in the blank: ______ means tribe L'État means state Le village means village Marié means married Célibataire means not married or single/ bachelor for a man.
La tribu means tribe L'État means state Le village means village Marié means married Célibataire means not married or single/ bachelor for a man.
Fill in the blank: ______ is used for giving orders or commands.
The imperative is used for giving orders or commands.
fib: ______ is used to tell about what will happen in the future e.g.
The future tense is used to tell about what will happen in the future e.g.
______ is used to replace a noun preceded by de e.g. i. - Et les fruits vous n'avez pas besoin de fruits? ii. - Si, j'en ai besoin.
The pronoun en is used to replace a noun preceded by de e.g. i. - Et les fruits vous n'avez pas besoin de fruits? ii. - Si, j'en ai besoin.
______ is used to identify a person or an object that is nearer the speaker.
Voici is used to identify a person or an object that is nearer the speaker.
